verdict.rationale: First-party docs show that `tofu plan` creates an execution plan for previewing infrastructure changes before applying them. Speculative plans let developers check the effect of changes, destroy mode plans the removal of all remote objects, and `-out=FILE` saves a plan that `tofu apply` later executes exactly as reviewed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the plan output breaking down creates/updates/destroys per resource, independent or hands-on corroboration of the plan preview.
